arxiv-1902-00366.title: A note on The maximal operators of the Nörlund logaritmic means of Vilenkin-Fourier series Thanks: The research was supported by Shota Rustaveli National Science Foundation grant YS-18-043.
arxiv-1902-00366.creator: George Tephnadze and Giorgi Tutberidze
arxiv-1902-00366.description: Abstract . The main aim of this paper is to investigate ( H p , L p ) \left(H_{p},L_{p}\right) - type inequalities for the the maximal operators of Nörlund logaritmic means, for 0 < p < 1 . 0<p<1. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification. 42C10. Key words and phrases: Vilenkin system, partial sums, Logarithmic means, martingale Hardy space. 1.

arxiv-2106-15017.title: Early Mobility Recognition for Intensive Care Unit Patients Using Accelerometers CCS: Applied computing Health care information systems
arxiv-2106-15017.creator: Rex Liu, Sarina A Fazio, Huanle Zhang, Albara Ah Ramli, Xin Liu, Jason Yeates Adams
arxiv-2106-15017.description: Abstract . With the development of the Internet of Things(IoT) and Artificial Intelligence(AI) technologies, human activity recognition has enabled various applications, such as smart homes and assisted living. In this paper, we target a new healthcare application of human activity recognition, early mobility recognition for Intensive Care Unit(ICU) patients.

arxiv-2110-09606.title: Efficient Analysis of COVID-19 Clinical Data using Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2110-09606.creator: Sarwan Ali, Yijing Zhou, Murray Patterson
arxiv-2110-09606.description: Abstract Because of the rapid spread of COVID-19 to almost every part of the globe, huge volumes of data and case studies have been made available, providing researchers with a unique opportunity to find trends and make discoveries like never before, by leveraging such big data.

arxiv-2202-05631.title: Vehicle and License Plate Recognition with Novel Dataset for Toll Collection
arxiv-2202-05631.creator: Muhammad Usama, Hafeez Anwar, Abbas Anwar, Saeed Anwar
arxiv-2202-05631.description: Abstract We propose an automatic framework for toll collection, consisting of three steps: vehicle type recognition, license plate localization, and reading. However, each of the three steps becomes non-trivial due to image variations caused by several factors. The traditional vehicle decorations on the front cause variations among vehicles of the same type.

arxiv-2204-06687.title: Designing Experiments Toward Shrinkage Estimation
arxiv-2204-06687.creator: Evan T. R. Rosenman, Luke Miratrix
arxiv-2204-06687.description: Abstract We consider how increasingly available observational data can be used to improve the design of randomized controlled trials (RCTs). We seek to design a prospective RCT, with the intent of using an Empirical Bayes estimator to shrink the causal estimates from our trial toward causal estimates obtained from an observational study.

arxiv-2205-08785.title: Parton distribution functions and intrinsic
arxiv-2205-08785.description: Abstract AAt LHCb, proton parton distribution functions (PDFs) can be studied in a unique phase space complementary to that accessible by ATLAS and CMS, corresponding to low and high values of Bjorken- x x . The measurements of vector boson production in the forward region, with and without an associated jet, are presented.

arxiv-2304-13833.title: Mixtures of Gaussian process experts based on kernel stick-breaking processes
arxiv-2304-13833.creator: Yuji Saikai, Khue-Dung Dang
arxiv-2304-13833.description: Abstract Mixtures of Gaussian process experts is a class of models that can simultaneously address two of the key limitations inherent in standard Gaussian processes: scalability and predictive performance. In particular, models that use Dirichlet processes as gating functions permit straightforward interpretation and automatic selection of the number of experts in a mixture.

arxiv-2306-09348.title: Seeing the World through Your Eyes
arxiv-2306-09348.creator: Hadi Alzayer* Kevin Zhang* Brandon Feng Christopher Metzler Jia-Bin Huang
arxiv-2306-09348.description: Abstract The reflective nature of the human eye is an underappreciated source of information about what the world around us looks like. By imaging the eyes of a moving person, we can collect multiple views of a scene outside the camera’s direct line of sight through the reflections in the eyes.

arxiv-2307-12011.title: Normal form for singular Bautin bifurcation in a slow-fast system with Holling type III functional response
arxiv-2307-12011.creator: Tapan Saha, Pranali Roy Chowdhury, Pallav Jyoti Pal, Malay Banerjee
arxiv-2307-12011.description: Abstract Over the last few decades, complex oscillations of slow-fast systems have been a key area of research. In the theory of slow-fast systems, the location of singular Hopf bifurcation and maximal canard is determined by computing the first Lyapunov coefficient.

arxiv-2309-05444.title: Pushing Mixture of Experts to the Limit: Extremely Parameter Efficient MoE for Instruction Tuning
arxiv-2309-05444.creator: name=Ted Zadouri, affiliation=Cohere for AI, email=ted@cohere.com, name=Ahmet Üstün, affiliation=Cohere for AI, email=ahmet@cohere.com, name=Arash Ahmadian †, affiliation=Cohere for AI, email=arash@cohere.com, name=Beyza Ermiş, affiliation=Cohere For AI, email=beyza@cohere.com, name=Acyr Locatelli,
arxiv-2309-05444.description: Abstract The Mixture of Experts (MoE) is a widely known neural architecture where an ensemble of specialized sub-models optimizes overall performance with a constant computational cost. However, conventional MoEs pose challenges at scale due to the need to store all experts in memory. In this paper, we push MoE to the limit.

arxiv-2405-18926.title: Newton Method Revisited: Global Convergence Rates up to 𝒪 ⁡ ( k − 3 ) \mathcal{O}\left(k^{-3}\right) for Stepsize Schedules and Linesearch Procedures
arxiv-2405-18926.creator: Slavomír Hanzely MBZUAI and Farshed Abdukhakimov MBZUAI and Martin Takáč MBZUAI
arxiv-2405-18926.description: Abstract This paper investigates the global convergence of stepsized Newton methods for convex functions with Hölder continuous Hessians or third derivatives. We propose several simple stepsize schedules with fast global convergence guarantees, up to 𝒪 ⁡ ( k − 3 ) \mathcal{O}\left(k^{-3}\right) .

arxiv-2512-18527.title: Detection of AI Generated Images Using Combined Uncertainty Measures and Particle Swarm Optimised Rejection Mechanism
arxiv-2512-18527.creator: Rahul Yumlembam, Biju Issac, Nauman Aslam, Eaby Kollonoor Babu, Josh Collyer, Fraser Kennedy
arxiv-2512-18527.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rahul Yumlembam, Biju Issac, Nauman Aslam, Eaby Kollonoor Babu, Josh Collyer, Fraser Kennedy. As AI-generated images become increasingly photorealistic, distinguishing them from natural images poses a growing challenge. This paper presents a robust detection framework that leverages multiple uncertainty measures to decide whether to trust or reject a model’s predictions.

arxiv-2601-21182.title: Rethinking Refinement: Correcting Generative Bias without Noise Injection
arxiv-2601-21182.creator: Xin Peng, Ang Gao
arxiv-2601-21182.description: Abstract Generative models, including diffusion and flow-based models, often exhibit systematic biases that degrade sample quality, particularly in high-dimensional settings. We revisit refinement methods and show that effective bias correction can be achieved as a post-hoc procedure, without noise injection or multi-step resampling of the sampling process.

europmc-pmc4657234.title: Epidemiology of diabetic retinopathy, diabetic macular edema and related vision loss.
europmc-pmc4657234.creator: Lee R, Wong TY, Sabanayagam C.
europmc-pmc4657234.description: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of vision-loss globally. Of an estimated 285 million people with diabetes mellitus worldwide, approximately one third have signs of DR and of these, a further one third of DR is vision-threatening DR, including diabetic macular edema...

plos-pone-0000557.creator: Simone S. Santos-Lopes, Rinaldo W. Pereira, Ian J. Wilson et al.
plos-pone-0000557.description: PLOS ONE research article. We reasoned that by identifying genetic markers on human X chromosome regions where recombination is rare or absent, we should be able to construct X chromosome genealogies analogous to those based on Y chromosome and mitochondrial DNA polymorphisms, with the advantage of providi

pmc-10625099.title: Nanoscale Oxygenous Heterogeneity in FePC Glass for Highly Efficient and Reusable Catalytic Performance
pmc-10625099.creator: Qi Chen, Lingyu Guo, Haoxiang Di, Zhigang Qi, Zhaoxuan Wang, Ziqi Song, Laichang Zhang, Lina Hu, Weimin Wang
pmc-10625099.description: Metallic glass, with its unique disordered atomic structure and high density of low‐coordination sites, is regarded as the most competitive new catalyst for environmental catalysis. However, the efficiency and stability of metallic glass catalysts are often affected by their atomic configuration.

pmc-11487067.title: Frugal engineering-inspired wearable augmented reality goggle system enables fluorescence-guided cancer surgery
pmc-11487067.creator: Leonid Shmuylovich, Christine M O’Brien, Karen Nwosu, Samuel Achilefu
pmc-11487067.description: Disparities in surgical outcomes often result from subjective decisions dictated by surgical training, experience, and available resources. To improve outcomes, surgeons have adopted advancements in robotics, endoscopy, and intra-operative imaging including fluorescence-guided surgery (FGS), which highlights tumors and anatomy in real-time. However, technical, economic, and logistic challenges hinder widespread adoption of FGS beyond high-resource centers.

pmc-12586833.title: Changing patterns of colorectal cancer in China between 2000 and 2016 based on tertiary hospital data
pmc-12586833.creator: Junling Wu, Hanwen Zhang, Zhe Luan, Jun Chen, Zhizhuang Zhao, Yiming Zhao, Congyong Li, Wei Zhang, Yi Chen, Jiaqi Zhang, Jiwei Zhao, Shuhuang Peng, Hanfei Liu, Jing Wang, Shufang Wang, Gang Sun
pmc-12586833.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer ranks fourth globally in cancer-related deaths, causing about nine million annual fatalities. Developed countries show higher mortality rates due to factors like aging, diet, obesity, inactivity, and tobacco use. While colonoscopy initiatives reduce incidence, early-onset cases rise. China faces a significant colorectal cancer burden.

pmc-12593277.title: CA turns 75: Looking at the future but never forgetting the roots
pmc-12593277.creator: Don S. Dizon, Sumanta Kumar Pal, Banu E. Symington, Razelle Kurzrock, Arif H. Kamal, Christina M. Annunziata, Shanthi Sivendran, Ahmedin Jemal, William L. Dahut
pmc-12593277.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). associated with the highest impact factor of any medical or scientific journal, inside and outside of oncology—a testament to its value, not only to professionals in this space but to the wider public at large. The core reason for its domestic and global reach is cancer statistics, a continuous and evolving effort to describe the incidence and mortality of cancers and how changes in exposures, diagnosis, and treatment affect them.

pmc-12638987.title: Origin of Earth’s hydrogen and carbon constrained by their core-mantle partitioning and bulk Earth abundance
pmc-12638987.creator: Yutaro Tsutsumi, Naoya Sakamoto, Kei Hirose, Shuhei Mita, Shunpei Yokoo, Han Hsu, Hisayoshi Yurimoto
pmc-12638987.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hydrogen and carbon concentrations in the Earth’s core are yet known. Here we determined their metal/silicate partition coefficients (D) simultaneously under typical conditions of core formation and found that DH and DC diminish in the presence of carbon and hydrogen, respectively, because of strong interactions between hydrogen and carbon in liquid metal, being markedly different from those separately examined in earlier experiments.

pmc-13036546.title: Concomitant Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump Throughout Extracorporeal Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation: A Meta-Analysis of Cohorts
pmc-13036546.creator: Huiruo Liu, Liangshan Wang, Hongfu Fu, Hong Wang, Xing Hao, Zhongtao Du, Chenglong Li, Xiaotong Hou
pmc-13036546.description: Background:Inconsistent reports exist regarding the efficacy of using a concomitant intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP) among cardiac arrest (CA) patients undergoing extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation (ECPR). Thus, this review was conducted to summarize the prognoses of adult ECPR patients with concurrent IABP.Methods:Data were gathered from PubMed, Embase, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and Cochrane databases.

pmc-13198853.title: Dietary Index for Gut Microbiota and Osteoporosis Risk in Chinese Postmenopausal Women: A Case–Control Study
pmc-13198853.creator: Xiaofeng Yin, Yiyun Guan, Weixiang Huang
pmc-13198853.description: BackgroundDiet influences bone health through modulation of gut microbiota. The current study aimed to assess the association between the dietary index for gut microbiota (DI-GM) and osteoporosis in Chinese populations.MethodsWe conducted a case-control study among 500 postmenopausal Chinese women (250 osteoporosis and 250 controls).

pmc-13396523.title: DFT and experimental evaluation of NiSnO₃ nanocomposites in photocatalytic applications
pmc-13396523.creator: Hocine SadamNesrat, Abdelatif Aouadi, Djamel Bezzerga, El-Abed Haidar, Sara Aouadi, Salah Eddine Laouini, Mohammed Messaoudi, Ayomide Victor Atoki, DalilaSaidane Mosbahi, Nader Shehata
pmc-13396523.description: The development of multifunctional nanomaterials capable of addressing energy and environmental challenges remains an important goal in materials research. Herein, NiSnO₃ ternary oxide was synthesized via a hydrothermal route and systematically investigated for its structural, optical, and functional properties. Structural and optical characterizations confirm the formation of a phase-pure, nanocrystalline material with a bandgap of approximately 1.

pmc-13409799.title: Rehabilitation Nutrition for Tendon and Ligament Injuries: From Collagen Remodeling to Return-to-Activity and Sport
pmc-13409799.creator: Eui-Jae Lee, Jooyoung Kim
pmc-13409799.description: Background/Objectives: Tendon and ligament injuries are challenging conditions because of limited vascularization, slow collagen turnover, and prolonged rehabilitation timelines. This narrative review aimed to synthesize current evidence on nutritional strategies that may support connective tissue rehabilitation and return-to-activity or return-to-sport progression.

pmc-13475121.title: The prevalence of the AR-V7 variant and its association with clinicopathologic characteristics in non-prostatic cancers—a systematic review
pmc-13475121.creator: Zaineh Alnoubani, Youssuf Khanafer, Adnan Fojnica, Emir Begagic, Inga Rose, Zoran Gatalica, Semir Vranic
pmc-13475121.description: Androgen receptor splice variant 7 (AR-V7) is associated with resistance to androgen receptor-targeting therapies in prostate cancer, but its prevalence and clinical relevance in non-prostatic cancers remain incompletely characterized. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. Thirty-four studies, including 4855 clinical cases and 60 cell lines, were included.

pmc-13585792.title: Adsorption-driven Graphene Oxide SPR Biointerfaces: Coupled Thermodynamic, Kinetic, and Optical Modeling with Effective-layer Validation
pmc-13585792.creator: Sadok Kouz

pmc-13644174.title: L-NAME promotes foam cell formation and synthetic phenotype marker changes in vascular smooth muscle cells independent of hemodynamic effects
pmc-13644174.creator: Huanhua Du, Jia Ling, Zheng Lu, Yutong Liu, Jinsong Yan, Junli Ma, Li Li, Gang Chen
pmc-13644174.description: ObjectiveThis study investigated whether L-NAME, a nitric oxide synthase (NOS) inhibitor commonly used to model hypertension-associated endothelial dysfunction, can exert direct pro-atherogenic effects on vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) independent of systemic hemodynamic influences.MethodsMouse aortic VSMCs (MOVAS) were treated with non-cytotoxic concentrations of L-NAME (50 µM) or oxidized low-density lipoprotein (ox-LDL, 100 µg/mL), which served as a positive atherogenic control.

uslaw-usc-t46-s15103.title: 46 U.S.C. § 15103 — National Merchant Marine Personnel Advisory Committee
uslaw-usc-t46-s15103.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s15103.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part K (National Maritime Transportation Advisory Committees); Chapter 151 (National Maritime Transportation Advisory Committees). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment.— There is established a National Merchant Marine Personnel Advisory Committee (in this section referred to as the “Committee”). (b) Function.— The Committee shall advise the Secretary on matters relating to personnel in the United States.
